title: Multiconic Optimization for Symmetric Cones and Hyperbolic Coupling
summary: We develop a new interior-point algorithm for solving multiconic optimization problems using the parabolic target space approach. The feasible cone in these problems is composed as a direct product of many small-dimensional cones. Our approach is based on a new concept, called the hyperbolic coupling. This provides a new framework that has an advantage of interdependent pairs of primal-dual variables. In this way, their behaviour is much more controllable.
